scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Frilldora?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
你打完50只傘蜥了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Remember, I need help hunting Frilldora so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
記住，我需要幫忙打傘蜥，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Please kill 50 Frilldora.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
請擊殺50只傘蜥。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
太棒了，你的速度真快。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
I am looking for lizard ^FF0000Frills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
我在找蜥蜴的^FF0000頸褶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
The lizards around here have a natural stealth, a property that the Assassin's Guild wants to study.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
這裡的蜥蜴天生具有隱身能力，刺客公會想要研究這種特性。

scripts.text: I have some Frills
scripts.translation: 我有一些傘蜥頸褶

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Hey, thank you.
These are pretty icky though.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
嘿，謝謝。
不過這些看起來真噁心。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Sigh,
Please, don't waste my time.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
唉，拜託，別浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
I need ^FF000025 Frills^000000 for the Assassin's Guild.

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Frilldora.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆利]
啊，看來你可以幫我獵殺一些傘蜥。
你想獵殺多少隻？

scripts.translation: 50只傘蜥

I can't believe I am stuck doing this.

scripts.text:

What are you doing here?
The desert will kill you here!
scripts.translation:

你在這裡做什麼？
這片沙漠會要了你的命！
